label: WATCH
rationale: ISRG is an Emerging Outlier with exceptional company quality: it leads robotic-assisted soft-tissue surgery, generates 85% recurring revenue, is expanding procedures and installed base, produces strong operating leverage and FCF, holds substantial cash, and offsets dilution with repurchases. At $365.56, however, the stock is approximately equal to the modeled Base value and requires roughly 14% annual revenue growth for ten years at a 30% terminal FCF margin. The expectation gap and asymmetry are insufficient for entry despite the business quality.
increase_evidence: Da Vinci procedure growth stabilizes at 15% or higher while utilization remains positive.
International procedure growth remains at least 18% and broadens across countries and specialties.
Da Vinci 5 improves recurring revenue per installed system without consolidated gross-margin deterioration.
Ion utilization accelerates as U.S. installed-base growth matures, confirming a durable second-platform model.
FCF per diluted share compounds at least 15% with flat or declining net shares.
Competitive launches do not cause material account losses, pricing pressure or weaker procedure growth.
Price falls at least 20% below a refreshed Base value, or stronger evidence raises Base value enough to create that gap.
reduce_or_exit_evidence: Da Vinci procedure growth stays below 10% for four quarters while installed-base growth and utilization also weaken.
A serious product-safety, recall, regulatory or cybersecurity event produces sustained loss of trust.
Competitors win material account share and recurring instruments or service revenue grows slower than procedures.
Gross margin stays below 62% or FCF margin stays below 22% for two years.
Net dilution exceeds 1.5% annually despite positive FCF and authorized repurchases.
Management allocates material capital to low-return acquisitions or persistently repurchases above intrinsic value as per-share economics weaken.
Price requires the full Bull case without proportionate improvement in business evidence.
